name: Legacy Landscapes Fund grants
summary: Long-term baseline funding of USD 1 million a year, for 15 years or in perpetuity, for experienced conservation NGOs managing large, intact protected areas and their buffer zones in ODA-eligible countries, with private match funding required.

geography.label: Countries eligible for Official Development Assistance (ODA)

reporting: Grantees submit an annual report (progress report, logframe and KPI table, financial report) and interim reports; the next year's funding tranche is released only after the annual report is accepted.

status.quote: LLF's open calls for proposals for the 1-1-1 and IP&LC calls are now closed.

deadline.quote: The deadline for submitting concept notes was 1 September 2025, 11:59 PM CEST.

applicant_types.quote: LLF grantees are non-governmental organizations (NGOs) with a strong local foothold

geography.quote: Be in a country eligible for Official Development Assistance (ODA) at the time the grant is awarded.

access.quote: LLF's open calls for proposals for the 1-1-1 and IP&LC calls are now closed.

window.quote: The deadline for submitting concept notes was 1 September 2025, 11:59 PM CEST.

amount.quote: Grant funding of one million USD per year is awarded to each legacy landscape

co_finance_required.quote: The ability to secure private match funding

reporting.quote: After having submitted the annual report and satisfactorily clarifying questions by LLF, LLF will no-object the annual report documents and disburse the tranche for the next funding year.
